title: Certified Verification of Polynomial Decompositions, Discrete Tomography Reconfiguration, and Legendre Cross-Polytope Slice Integrals
abstract: We construct a standalone zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core discrete-tomography, integer-polynomial-ring, Proposition 3.7 Cramer-elimination, Legendre/Murphy, Theorem 1.6 global cross-polytope slice-integral, and cyclotomic-factorization theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice) for Peter Keevash and Jeck Lim (arXiv:2611.33120, Nov 2026), paired with a zero-floating-point exact rational/integer four-mode certificate verifier (POLY-DECOMP-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.062-2.740 ms, total 8.07 ms), all exact Theorem 1.6 slice polynomials, m-basic polynomial decompositions, multi-directional discrete tomography switch chains, Proposition 3.7 filling-norm witnesses, and cyclotomic factorizations replay deterministically while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.

reference_work.title: Efficient reconfiguration, polynomial decompositions and approximate counting

ai_assistance_disclosure: Prepared by sole author Lluis Eriksson with AI coding, formalization, and drafting assistance from Google Antigravity; all Lean 4 proofs, exact rational/integer certificates, and adversarial tests were independently compiled and machine-verified locally.
